errors: The problem says operations from different jobs only 'may' share a machine, but the model forces every operation of every job onto one machine. It adds non-overlap constraints for all 4 operation pairs of every job pair. This makes the model a 12-operation single-machine problem with makespan about 12, and a real machine assignment would almost certainly give a much smaller makespan.

The reported objective of 11.99976 instead of an integer value shows big-M tolerance leakage. Binaries of about 3e-9 times M=100000 relax the constraints by about 3e-4, so the solution slightly violates the non-overlap constraints.
